notes_for_editor: Only two sources exist in the caches or search results: the tnlandforms list (name, county, elevation, code 8-8, removed) and the NRHP Tennessee Division of Forestry multiple property document, which does not name this tower. No Forest Lookouts, NHLR or firetower.org page for Huntingdon was found. The agency is inferred from the 8-8 code, which tnlandforms calls a state forest tower number; treat it as likely, not confirmed. The Carroll County NHLR towers (Leach, Maple Lake) are different towers and are not used. Built, staffing, fire and access facts are absent from every source read, so the story omits them. Two web searches and one NRHP read were spent on this tower. Next step if more work is wanted: a Carroll County or Division of Forestry newspaper or board record naming the 8-8 tower, and a check of the 1976 district map.
